near_miss.rationale: Treat kappa1 as defined on Q1 for a window with d1 d0 != 0 (the representatives 0 and d0 e_0 of the zero class have different d1 values).
Ignore the closure charge: the filled triangle with Gamma2 = 2 is called a closed residual.
Call the unfilled triangle class exact because Gamma2 = 0; its Phi1 is 1, so the class is a nonzero element of H1.
Read the sum of edge residuals (the source Lean list sum) as Phi1; the quotient defect is the minimum over potentials and is smaller (3 vs 5 on K4).
Compute Phi1 with unit weights for a window whose norm J has weight 3 on every edge.
Take dim H1 = dim ker d1 (cycles) without quotienting by im d0.
Report R_cl = 0 for an exact class, as the Rust TriadSignature::r_cl convention does; the node statement defines R_cl = Gamma2/Phi1 only when Phi1 > 0.
Claim a potential repairs a loop edge; d0 of a loop is zero so Phi1 = 3 there.
Report the unrepaired residual sum 4 for h + d0 (0,1,1); Phi1 and R_cl are class functions and stay 2 and 1.
Weight Gamma2 by J (6 for the weight-3 triangle); Gamma2 is the unweighted L1 norm of d1 h, so R_cl = 1/3 is scale dependent by definition.
Swap the quotient: dim Q1 = m - rank d1 (dimension of cycles) instead of m - rank d0.
Accept the row (1,1,1) as a 2-cell because its coboundary vanishes mod 2; over Q it gives d1 d0 e_0 = -2.
Report Gamma2 = 2 for the window with d1 d0 != 0; there Gamma2 depends on the representative (0 at h = 0, 2 at h = 2), so no class value exists.
Carry the zero potential as the primal witness of the exact class h = (1,2,3); its cost is 6, not Phi1 = 0.
Carry the dual vector (2,2,-2) for the unit-weight triangle: it annihilates coboundaries and pairs to 4 but violates |y_e| <= w_e, so it is no lower bound.
Hide the NoRule refusal of a window with d1 d0 != 0 behind an ActiveClosureFailure line with a finite ratio.
